# Saudi Cabs GMC

> Saudi Cabs GMC is a private taxi and chauffeur service operating across Saudi Arabia — Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah, Taif, and intercity routes to Riyadh and Dammam. Fixed prices agreed before travel (no meter), airport transfers, Hajj & Umrah transport, private driver hire, and a fleet of Toyota Camry sedans, Hyundai Staria vans, and GMC Yukon SUVs. Booking is via WhatsApp: +92 309 7811785.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://saudicabsgmc.com/): Overview of services, cities served, and fleet.
- [About](https://saudicabsgmc.com/about): Who Saudi Cabs GMC is and how the service works.
- [Book a Taxi](https://saudicabsgmc.com/booking): Booking form — vehicle, route, date, time, passengers, flight number, luggage, special requests.
- [FAQ](https://saudicabsgmc.com/faq): Common questions grouped by city.
- [Reviews](https://saudicabsgmc.com/reviews): Passenger feedback.
- [Contact](https://saudicabsgmc.com/contact): WhatsApp, phone, and email contact details.
- [Team](https://saudicabsgmc.com/team): Chauffeurs, dispatch, support, and fleet maintenance.
- [Routes Map](https://saudicabsgmc.com/routes-map): Interactive map of all served cities and routes.

## Specialized Services

- [Airport Transfer](https://saudicabsgmc.com/airport-transfer): Jeddah (KAIA), Madinah, and Taif airport pickups.
- [Hajj & Umrah Transport](https://saudicabsgmc.com/hajj-umrah-transport): Transfers to Mina, Arafat, Muzdalifah, and between the holy cities.
- [Private Driver](https://saudicabsgmc.com/private-driver): Full-day chauffeur hire.
- [Makkah Ziyarat Tour](https://saudicabsgmc.com/makkah-ziyarat-tour)
- [Madinah Ziyarat Tour](https://saudicabsgmc.com/madinah-ziyarat-tour)

## Notes

- Prices are fixed and agreed before travel; no meter, no surge pricing.
- Bookings are confirmed via WhatsApp (+92 309 7811785), not through an online payment checkout.
- The central areas of Makkah and Madinah (around Masjid al-Haram and Masjid an-Nabawi) are restricted to Muslims only, per Saudi regulations — this applies regardless of transport arrangements.
